description: Reads the DOT language of Graphviz into the flowcharts of Meziantou.Framework.Diagrams, drawn as deterministic SVG without Graphviz, and writes flowcharts as DOT: nodes, edges, clusters, shapes, styles, colors, record and HTML-like labels.
